name: ESWATINI

flag.title: Shield & Spears
flag.note: Blue, red & yellow — shield unites all

lead: Eswatini is a small kingdom between South Africa and Mozambique. It has no coast. You could drive across it in two hours. The king's family has led the Swazi (the people of Eswatini) for over 200 years.

facts.label: Land area
facts.sub: Smaller than Wales or New Jersey

sections.animals: Big game in a tiny kingdom
sections.history: From Ngwane III to Mswati III
sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Eswatini slopes down from cool mountains in the west to hot, flat savanna in the east. Malolotja Falls plunge 89 metres.
The Ezulwini Valley means 'Place of Heaven'. It holds the royal palace and parliament. Nearby, Sibebe Rock is a granite dome three billion years old.
animals: Hlane Royal National Park shelters white rhinos, elephants, lions, giraffes and hippos. Rangers guard the rhinos closely, making Eswatini one of southern Africa's rhino success stories.
Eswatini is one of Africa's few breeding sites for the rare blue swallow. Over 500 bird species have been recorded.
culture: Every August, up to 40,000 unmarried girls gather for the Umhlanga Reed Dance. Each girl cuts a reed and gives it to the Queen Mother, the king's mother. Then they dance in beaded costumes.
Each December, the Incwala ceremony renews the king's power with six days of ancient songs. Swazi craftspeople make woven baskets and hand-poured candles sold worldwide.
history: The Swazi kingdom took shape in the mid-1700s under King Ngwane III. King Mswati II grew it so large that the people took his name. British protection began in the 1890s. Independence came in 1968.
In 2018, King Mswati III renamed Swaziland as Eswatini, meaning 'Land of the Swazis'. It was the 50th independence anniversary. He is Africa's only remaining absolute monarch, a king with full power.
wows: Eswatini is Africa's last absolute monarchy. The king holds full power.
Sibebe Rock is 3 billion years old, one of Earth's largest granite domes.
Malolotja reserve is one of the few African breeding sites for the blue swallow.
Eswatini is the only African country with official ties to Taiwan, an island in Asia.
Eswatini's money, the lilangeni, is worth exactly the same as South Africa's rand.
Eswatini is Africa's 4th-biggest sugar producer, yet smaller than Wales, part of Britain.
Up to 40,000 people join the Umhlanga Reed Dance, one of Africa's biggest gatherings.

myths.fact: Lesotho and Morocco are kingdoms too.

myths.fact: It is made of keratin, the same stuff as your fingernails and hair.
